<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 144.78 ppm (1 carbon), 132.00 ppm (1 carbon), 130.07 ppm (appears twice, representing 2 carbons), and 127.80 ppm (appears twice, representing 2 carbons). Summing these gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
